*Biped* is a physics-based cooperative adventure game. You and a partner will take on the roles of “Aku” and “Sila”—two small, bipedal alien robots—as you embark on a fun and exhilarating adventure on Earth. Together, you will traverse diverse and stunning landscapes, relying on teamwork and mutual support to solve puzzles and overcome challenges. Your ultimate goal? It’s simple and straightforward, yet offers a high degree of freedom, allowing for all sorts of incredible maneuvers and precise movements. – Cooperative gameplay: A true test of synergy While the game can be played solo, *Biped* truly shines in two-player co-op. Some challenges emphasize synchronization, others focus on collaborative effort, and some even put the trust and patience between partners to the test. These inventive co-op challenges are a great way to build synergy—and perhaps even put your friendship or relationship to the ultimate test! – 30 beautiful, fun-filled levels The story unfolds on a beautiful planet, where nature remains pristine, dotted with paths and contraptions built by the Biped aliens—along with the occasional trace of artificial structures. It is in this world that our two adorable protagonists begin their journey. From ancient, long-forgotten ruins and treacherous icy cliffs to rushing canyon waterfalls and mysterious, lush forests, there are 30 distinct, visually stunning levels packed with fun challenges waiting for you to conquer. – Collect treasures and customize your Biped Beyond the ingenious puzzles and obstacles, the game is filled with hidden treasures scattered throughout the world, just waiting for you to discover and collect them.
